meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 vercel CLI 帮你把 web 应用部署到 Vercel(生产或预览),并管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署前先跑本地构建,部署后确认线上 URL 正常响应,再把链接给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署、上线或发布一个 web 应用,或要管理 Vercel 的项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: 先跑本地构建,再部署生产环境

say.text: 看看我最近有哪些 Vercel 部署
把 example.com 加到当前 Vercel 项目
say.note: 给当前项目添加该域名

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude deploys your web app to Vercel via the vercel CLI (production or preview), and manages projects, domains and env vars. It runs a local build first, then checks the live URL responds before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to deploy, ship or publish a web app, or to manage Vercel projects, domains or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production
say_en.note: Runs the local build first, then deploys

say_en.text: Show me my recent Vercel deployments
Add example.com to the current Vercel project
say_en.note: Adds the domain to the linked project
